description.zh: 需要删除的自定义转码模板ID。可以通过**MPS控制台**>**全局设置**>**转码模板**获取。
description.en: The ID of the custom transcoding template that you want to delete. To obtain the ID of the custom transcoding template, you can log on to the **ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) console** and choose **Global Settings** > **Encoding Templates** in the left-side navigation pane.

descriptions.zh:
如果有状态为“已提交”的作业指定使用该自定义转码模板，则相应的转码模板不能被删除。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
A custom transcoding template cannot be deleted if it is being used by a job that has been submitted.

### QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342832~~).
